calendar: fixed consecutive daily steps; leap days retained; no annual resets; 1825 steps can end before the fifth calendar anniversary
terminal_target_scope: end of the entire episode only; seasonal hard deadlines still apply each year
evaluation: one continuous validation sequence; final representative test years are concatenated in configured order with storage carried between them
model_scope: paper collection layout only; reward, observation and optimizer definitions remain explicit below

years.reward_aggregation: sum(gamma**t * daily_reward), t=0 at episode start
years.source_sequence: ordered source years; storage carries across every boundary; leap days retained
